subject: [hw] DONE DEC01 rev 3: unchanged acceptance 999/999; ion share budget + atomic hw_error + DEC02 independent validation
body:
DONE DEC01 rev 3. Deltas since the rev-2 DONE, all found by review/self-review after it; acceptance is the same:

  bash gpu/hwcodec/ap/test_dec01/run_tests.sh
  DEC01 asan/o2/tsan PASS 333/333 each
  N2VDEC reached VD-b/c/d/e, frames: in=1 displayed=1
  vectors: t320bf0 12/12, t320bf2 12/12, t1080bf0 4/4, t1080bf2 4/4 displayed; HEVC 2 stop at VD-c (named)
  N2TEST DEC01 PASS 999/999

1) DEC02 found the ion table is a shared 64-slot budget (N2AND_ION_BUFS; vpud takes ~34, a decode client ~28). The probe now registers 2 bitstream shares + dpb+2 frame buffers x 2 planes (26-28, was 4+32) and checks every n2shim_ion_register_share() return; a failed registration stops the pool instead of leaving an unimportable buffer. Vectors still display every AU (12/12 at 320x240 with a 12-buffer pool, 4/4 at 1080p with 10). DEC05: its one-allocation-per-buffer pool is dpb+2 shares, inside the budget.
2) hw_error is now atomic (first backend error wins; set in the WAITISR and power paths, exchanged by the sender), and a full output queue no longer leaves a displayed buffer marked in-use forever: the picture is synced and the entry released even when the client is too slow to queue it.
3) Independent validation: hw-dec02 rev 2 now drives this exact client (ap/n2ap_vdec.c) in its trace harness and reports N2TEST DEC02 PASS 12/12 - 12/12 AUs at 320x240 and 6/6 at 1080p, 18 VDEC pages, 0 GCE, 0 fake violations (with its /tmp page-map staging). Its two findings about the earlier revision (no harvest after START, chroma plane zeroed) were my H2/H1 review fixes.
4) DEC02's larb finding (release value 0x00010000) is K02's allow-list, not this client; I forwarded the value set. The racing restore at LOCK_LAT with CORE off is the PLAN-mandated LAT=SOC role; the EACCES is tolerated and documented in ap/VDEC_FLOW.md section 5 (DEC02's option (b) is the kernel/model side; option (a) would contradict the package spec).

No phone, nothing published. Full table and evidence: gpu/hwcodec/dsh-state/workers/DEC01/STATUS.md. Staying on the board.
